clubs.name: Didcot Wargames
clubs.summary: Tabletop and board games in the Didcot area. We meet every Thursday (7-11 pm) at North Moreton Village Hall, OX11 9AS.
clubs.description: Tabletop and board games in the Didcot area. We meet every Thursday (7-11 pm) at North Moreton Village Hall, OX11 9AS.  Didcot Wargames Club is a group for playing a variety of tabletop games and board games. We play Warhammer 40k, Age of Sigmar and many popular board games. We have plenty of space for games, and have spare gaming mats and terrain, if you want to come along and don't have supplies (just let us know in advance so we can bring them along).  We have a range of abilities and levels at the club, so beginners are welcome. We offer free coaching to players to help improve their skills. Your first night is free!  Any questions, send us a message.

clubs.name: Abingdon Games Club
clubs.summary: AWC is a friendly tabletop wargames club in Abingdon, Oxfordshire and was established in the "Reading room" in 1993 by a small number of like minded gamers. Shortly after the club expanded and moved to the "Neave Room" at the local Conservative Club where we are attended by individuals who are fun loving and passionate about wargaming.
